summary: A Sydney skin and beauty brand with treatments and a shop is a strength, but five dead menu links and leftover template text appear to cost you sales and bookings.

findings.problem: Five menu items (By Concern, Collections, Bath and Body, Brands A to K and Brands L to Z) appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Shoppers who browse by concern or brand land nowhere and leave.
findings.fix: Working collection pages for every menu item.

findings.problem: The text 'Describe what your customers will receive when subscribing to your newsletter' and the carousel labels 'Go to item 1 Go to item 2' appear visibly on the page.
findings.cost: Leftover template text makes a premium brand look unfinished.
findings.fix: Clean, finished copy and hidden carousel labels.

findings.problem: The practitioner name appears as Madonna in one review and Madona in three others, and Lip Balm appears to link to the same page as Treatments and Serums.
findings.cost: Spelling and link mismatches weaken trust and confuse shoppers.

findings.problem: Testimonials appear with no dates, ratings or surnames, one attributed to 'DIY VACATION', and one appears to say the client is now overseas.
findings.cost: Thin and odd proof gives a new customer little reason to trust the brand.
findings.fix: Verified reviews with dates and ratings.

redesign: Consistent names, verified reviews and correct links.
